description:
List campaign use cases

Returns the selectable messaging purposes and the allowed selection count. Campaign registration types are derived automatically from the brand profile and selected purposes.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/10dlc-campaigns/list-campaign-use-cases
name: listTenDlcCampaignUseCases

code.description: Known values: ["2FA","ACCOUNT_NOTIFICATION","CUSTOMER_CARE","DELIVERY_NOTIFICATION","FRAUD_ALERT","HIGHER_EDUCATION","MARKETING","POLLING_VOTING","PUBLIC_SERVICE_ANNOUNCEMENT","SECURITY_ALERT"]. Others may be added.

title: List campaign use cases
